primary_task: Fine-tune a language model with TRL (e.g. SFT) by writing a training script and submitting it as a Hugging Face Jobs cloud-GPU job that pushes the trained model to the Hugging Face Hub, then report the job ID and monitoring URL.

requirements.name: hf_jobs (Hugging Face MCP tool) or `hf jobs` CLI
requirements.evidence: "ALWAYS use `hf_jobs()` MCP tool ... you MUST create the training script AND submit the job immediately using `hf_jobs()`." ; alternative: "When the `hf_jobs()` MCP tool is unavailable, use the `hf jobs` CLI directly." (either one satisfies; both submit to huggingface.co)
requirements.basis: lacks: "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed" (no Hugging Face connector is listed); the CLI alternative needs huggingface.co, which is in egress_deny: "huggingface.co"

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: "Train language models using TRL ... on fully managed Hugging Face infrastructure" ; "Monitor: https://huggingface.co/jobs/username/abc123xyz" ; push_to_hub=True
requirements.basis: lacks: "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co, Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA"

requirements.name: Hugging Face paid account and HF_TOKEN (write)
requirements.evidence: "Hugging Face Account with Pro, Team, or Enterprise plan (Jobs require paid plan)" ; "MUST pass `secrets={"HF_TOKEN": "$HF_TOKEN"}` in job config" ; "Token must have write permissions"
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)"

requirements.name: publishes / writes_external (push model to Hub)
requirements.evidence: "Hub push must be enabled" ; "EPHEMERAL ENVIRONMENT—MUST PUSH TO HUB"

requirements.name: cloud GPU (HF Jobs flavor such as a10g-large)
requirements.evidence: "Fine-tune language models on cloud GPUs without local infrastructure" ; "flavor": "a10g-large"
requirements.basis: lacks: "a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)" (no local GPU; the remote GPU is reachable only through the refused huggingface.co)

requirements.name: uv
requirements.evidence: "Run them with `uv run`: uv run scripts/estimate_cost.py --help" (local helper scripts, optional)
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)"

requirements.name: trackio / trl / peft (in job script)
requirements.evidence: "Always include Trackio" ; "# dependencies = [\"trl>=0.12.0\", \"peft>=0.7.0\", \"trackio\"]" (installed inside the remote job, not the session)
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)"

credential:Hugging Face paid account and HF_TOKEN (write)

notes: No reading makes this achievable: the only documented paths to train (hf_jobs MCP, hf jobs CLI, trl-jobs) all submit to Hugging Face infrastructure, huggingface.co is refused, there is no HF credential and no local GPU. Even writing the training script alone is not the deliverable ("you MUST ... submit the job immediately"). If the primary task were read as only 'write a training script', it would be achievable, but the document does not allow that reading for a train request. GGUF conversion and cost estimation are optional follow-ups.
